name: Freelancer Support System – Client Ticket Manager
author: gayatripol

sections.description:
Managing client requests across WhatsApp, email, and calls can quickly become messy and unorganized.

Freelancer Support System helps freelancers and developers manage all client requests in one place by converting them into structured tickets directly inside WordPress.

No more missed messages. No more confusion. Everything organized, tracked, and easy to manage.

Save time, reduce communication gaps, and handle client work more efficiently.

Built to solve real freelancer workflow challenges.

Key Features

  • Centralized ticket system for managing client requests
  • Convert client messages into structured tasks
  • Track ticket status (Pending, In Progress, Completed)
  • Send WhatsApp updates to clients
  • Clean and simple admin dashboard
  • Lightweight and fast performance
  • Easy setup with no complex configuration

Who is this plugin for?

  • Freelancers managing multiple clients
  • WordPress developers handling client change requests
  • Agencies managing multiple websites
  • Anyone tired of scattered communication

Why use this plugin?

  • Keeps all client communication organized
  • Reduces missed requests and confusion
  • Improves productivity and workflow
  • Simple alternative to complex helpdesk tools
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/freelancer-support-system directory, or install via WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the plugin dashboard from the admin menu.
  4. Start managing client tickets easily.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require any external service?

No, it works completely inside WordPress.

Can clients submit requests?

Yes, clients can submit requests which are converted into tickets.

Does it support WhatsApp notifications?

Yes, you can enable WhatsApp updates for clients.

Is it suitable for agencies?

Yes, it works well for freelancers and small agencies.
